description:
Modern high-rise condo in Downtown Nashville, just an 8-minute walk to Broadway. Enjoy skyline views, bold style, and a cozy queen bed with plush bedding. Features include high-speed WiFi, smart TV, full kitchen, self check-in, pool, sky lounge, and fitness center. Perfect for girls’ trips, couples, and weekend getaways.

Permit#: T2022059368

The space
Enjoy a Stay in this Newly- Designed 1-bedroom apartment. This one bedroom apartment features a queen sized bed which gives you room to SLEEP 2! Enjoy amenities that this property offers a range of luxurious amenities designed to enhance comfort, convenience, and entertainment for its residents includes a dishwasher, Wi-Fi, AC, washer/ dryer and a fitness room, pool,sky lounge & THE USAGE OF COWGIRL/ BOY HATS. 

Step outside and find yourself just steps away from Nashville's top attractions, including Bridgestone Arena, the Country Music Hall of Fame, Music City Center, Nissan Stadium, Broadway, Assembly Food Hall, the Ryman Auditorium, and more.

🤠 BROADWAY: 8 mins (walking distance)
🤠 BRIDGESTONE: 7 mins (walking distance)
🤠 MUSIC CITY CENTER: 6 mins (walking distance)
🤠 NISSAN STADIUM: 6 min (drive) 
🤠 ASSEMBLY FOOD HALL: 6 mins (drive)
🤠BNA (airport) 12 min (drive)
🤠OPRYLAND 15 min (drive)

Guest access
Guests will be granted access to the entire unit and all of the property's amenities which includes the lobby, courtyard, sky lounge, swimming pool, & gym. Please, make yourself at home. We are not responsible for the closure or unavailability of any of these shared amenities, which is completely out of our control. Should this situation occur, we will not be able to refund any of your stay with us.

Other things to note
Thank you for staying with us!

(Any result in evidence of smoking, during your stay will result in FEES)
